lines: She having become nāḍī-form body should spread this; in venerable Svacchanda there is said as leaf by its threads.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sā nāḍīrūpatāmetya dehaṃ saṃtānayedimam śrīsvacchande@ta evoktaṃ yathā parṇaṃ svatantubhiḥ
